{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "direct-judge",
  "task_id": "LEV-CH01-ADVECTION-LINEAR-FLUX-CANONICAL-20260908",

  "dossier_sha256": "d9a041a3086b5b6e6391caecfea089ce834072d14d91fc97ee40e52f5b9167f4",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "NumStability.IsIntegralConservationLawSolution",
      "interpretation": "For every real a, b, and time, the spatial slice is interval integrable and its interval integral has time derivative flux(q(a,t)) minus flux(q(b,t)).",
      "effect_on_target": "Assumes the homogeneous interval mass balance for the embedded scalar density and prescribed linear flux, at every time.",
      "source_match": "Matches equation (1.10) and its endpoint signs. It excludes production and loss, but does not express the selected paragraph's separate source-term requirement.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "NumStability.constantCoefficientScalarMatrix",
      "interpretation": "The one-by-one real matrix whose sole entry is speed.",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses one fixed real coefficient in the flux.",
      "source_match": "Matches constant velocity ū and the scalar specialization of A.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "NumStability.constantLinearFlux",
      "interpretation": "Maps a state to its matrix-vector product with the coefficient matrix.",
      "effect_on_target": "With D002, the sole flux component is speed times the sole state component.",
      "source_match": "Matches f(q)=Aq and its stated scalar instance f(q)=ūq, without an additive constant.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "NumStability.leveque01_equation02_scalarAdvectionAt",
      "interpretation": "An abbreviation for IsLinearAdvectionSolutionAt with the same q, speed, x, and t.",
      "effect_on_target": "The second conclusion asserts the derivative-based scalar advection predicate at every x.",
      "source_match": "Preserves the arguments and equation (1.2).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "NumStability.scalarAsOneComponentSystem",
      "interpretation": "Maps q(x,t) to the function on Fin 1 constantly equal to q(x,t).",
      "effect_on_target": "Embeds the scalar density into a single component without changing its value or variables.",
      "source_match": "A reversible representation of the source's m=1 case.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "NumStability.IsIntegralConservationLawSolution._proof_1",
      "interpretation": "Asserts continuity of pointwise real scalar multiplication on real-valued function spaces with their product topology.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the continuity instance used by the vector-valued derivative predicate.",
      "source_match": "Supports ordinary real componentwise calculus without an extra physical hypothesis.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "NumStability.IsLinearAdvectionSolutionAt",
      "reuse_sha256": "6ac97ffa3b30810242d0a50f1519409ad3686b150047f12ffd20b05fe526f18c",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires actual time and space slice derivatives of q whose scalar residual is qt+speed*qx=0.",
      "source_match": "Exactly represents the classical scalar equation (1.2), including existence of the derivatives.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "NumStability.IsLinearAdvectionSolutionAt._proof_1",
      "reuse_sha256": "864627c748f3b3e8000a1d3c81b97f5344e352ddc3b6b8a397220bdb990f8655",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides continuous real scalar multiplication for the scalar advection derivative predicate.",
      "source_match": "Uses standard real calculus.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "interpretation": "Projects the additive monoid field of an additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real addition in the scalar-action instance chain.",
      "source_match": "Does not change the addition in the conservation or advection equations.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "Algebra.id",
      "interpretation": "The self-algebra with identity algebra map and multiplication as scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Identifies the real scalar action on Real with ordinary multiplication.",
      "source_match": "Matches multiplication by ū.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Algebra.toSMul",
      "interpretation": "Projects an algebra's scalar multiplication field.",

      "source_match": "Preserves the source's real coefficient multiplication.",
      "status": "pass"

      "name": "And",

      "effect_on_target": "Requires both the exact flux identity and the pointwise advection conclusion; also joins integrability with interval balance in D001.",

      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Continuous",
      "interpretation": "The library continuity predicate for a function between its specified topological spaces.",

      "source_match": "A sufficient regularity condition for converting interval residual identities into pointwise equality, consistent with section 1.1.2.",
      "status": "pass"
    },

      "source_match": "Preserves ordinary real differentiation.",
      "status": "pass"

      "name": "DistribMulAction.toMulAction",
      "interpretation": "Projects the multiplicative action underlying a distributive action.",

      "status": "pass"

      "status": "pass"
    },
    {

      "name": "Fin.instOfNat",
      "interpretation": "Interprets a numeral in nonempty Fin n using Fin.ofNat.",

      "status": "pass"

    {

      "status": "pass"

    {

      "name": "HMul.hMul",

      "status": "pass"

    {
